title: Detect client-side, enforce at the Privilege gateway
lede: The four Tool & Agent Safety categories of the PingOne Privilege AI Gateway guardrails: the scanner sees the poison, the schema mismatch, the abusive call and the hostile Agent Card before an agent acts — and the Privilege gateway is where the same attacks are enforced on live calls.

scan.label: This lab: scan at ingest / dispatch

enforce.label: PingOne Privilege: enforce at the gateway

nodes.label: The user asks an innocent question

steps.title: The user asks something innocent
steps.what: "What's the weather in Denver?" The user never asked for money to move.
steps.why: Every attack below works without the user noticing anything.

steps.title: Tool poisoning reaches the agent
steps.what: A hostile MCP server serves tool descriptions and inputSchema defaults that carry hidden instructions (tool_poisoning). The agent ingests them as trusted context.
steps.why: Nothing in MCP inspects tool metadata; the poison arrives byte-for-byte.

steps.title: Inter-agent abuse reaches the agent
steps.what: A hostile A2A specialist serves an Agent Card claiming orchestrator authority (inter_agent_abuse). A generalist that trusts the card obeys it.
steps.why: A2A discovery does not inspect card text either.

steps.title: This lab scans before the agent acts
steps.what: The scanner flags the poison, a schema-violating call (schema_violation), and schema-valid but hostile arguments (tool_abuse). It REPORTS — it never blocks.
steps.why: A defense can only sit where the data is consumed. This is the detect half.

steps.title: PingOne Privilege enforces the call
steps.what: The Privilege AI Gateway evaluates the tool call against policy: deny, hold for human approval (428), reject malformed input (400), refuse an unauthenticated agent (401).
steps.why: Detection informs; the gateway is the enforcement point. The AI-DEMO2 Attack Lab shows these verdicts live.

steps.title: Only a permitted call reaches the tool
steps.what: create_transfer runs only when policy permitted it. The demo stub moves no money.
steps.why: The user's innocent question ends with the user's intent, not the attacker's.
